newsitem.title: UK: British designer launches easy-fit condom.
newsitem.headline: British designer launches easy-fit condom.

text.p: A British designer launched an easy-to-fit condom on Monday that he hopes will take the angst out of donning the device. Designer Keith Jones spent six years devising the Topaz, the first condom that comes with an applicator. "I didn't want to do something merely cosmetic like changing the packaging. I wanted to make the product better and less interruptive," Jones said.
Anne Weyman, chief executive of Britain's Family Planning Association, gave Topaz her approval.
"Some couples do worry that they haven't put the condom on correctly or that it's been damaged. The packaging and applicator ring that come with Topaz minimise these risks."
The condom comes in a small plastic pot, along with its expandable applicator ring, and fits into a special carrying case.
After use the container forms a two-sided snap-shut pot for hygienic disposal.
